subject.title: [Feature]: Guided CLI onboarding with live AI verification (macOS parity) and classic fallback

question: Should flagless interactive CLI onboarding switch from chat-first setup to a deterministic guided live-verification flow once the linked PR's credential and workspace blockers are resolved?
rationale: The code boundary is clear, but the default first-run CLI UX, auth persistence posture, and fallback ladder are compatibility-sensitive product choices, and the issue has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Adopt guided default after blockers
options.body: Make guided live verification the default once detected credentials remain usable for first chat, classic verification uses the selected workspace, and the branch is mergeable.

options.title: Ship guided flow as opt-in first
options.body: Keep chat-first onboarding as the default while exposing the guided verifier behind an explicit command or flag until broader real-user proof exists.

options.title: Narrow to verification repair
options.body: Leave the current chat-first flow shape in place and add only live verification or clearer recovery around the existing setup path.

recommendation.title: Adopt guided default after blockers
recommendation.body: Make guided live verification the default once detected credentials remain usable for first chat, classic verification uses the selected workspace, and the branch is mergeable.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked issue/PR and the recent onboarding surfaces that define the parity target.
